import base64,json,subprocess
from urllib.parse import quote
repo="BestNameYet/Terminals"
directory="workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/expression-inventory"
names=["babel-parser-ast-spec.md","babel-parser-ast-LICENSE"]

def gh(method,endpoint,payload=None):
    args=["gh","api","--method",method,"repos/"+repo+"/"+endpoint]
    if payload is not None: args.extend(["--input","-"])
    cp=subprocess.run(args,input=json.dumps(payload) if payload is not None else None,
                      text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=90)
    if cp.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(method+" "+endpoint+" failed: "+cp.stderr[-1400:])
    return json.loads(cp.stdout)
links=[]
for name in names:
    link=directory+"/"+name
    target="../../../references/"+name
    try:
        gh("GET","contents/"+quote(link,safe="/")+"?ref=main")
    except RuntimeError as error:
        if "404" not in str(error): raise
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("Already exists: "+link)
    assert gh("GET","contents/references/"+name+"?ref=main")["type"]=="file"
    blob=gh("POST","git/blobs",{"content":base64.b64encode(target.encode()).decode(),"encoding":"base64"})
    links.append({"path":link,"target":target,"mode":"120000","type":"blob","sha":blob["sha"]})
current=gh("GET","git/ref/heads/main")["object"]["sha"]
tree=gh("GET","git/commits/"+current)["tree"]["sha"]
newtree=gh("POST","git/trees",{"base_tree":tree,
    "tree":[{"path":l["path"],"mode":"120000","type":"blob","sha":l["sha"]} for l in links]})["sha"]
commit=gh("POST","git/commits",{"message":"Link Babel AST specification and license in expression inventory workspace",
                                  "tree":newtree,"parents":[current]})["sha"]
gh("PATCH","git/refs/heads/main",{"sha":commit,"force":False})
committed=gh("GET","git/commits/"+commit)
all_entries=gh("GET","git/trees/"+committed["tree"]["sha"]+"?recursive=1")["tree"]
index={entry["path"]:entry for entry in all_entries}
for link in links:
    entry=index.get(link["path"])
    assert entry is not None and entry["mode"]=="120000" and entry["sha"]==link["sha"],entry
    blob=gh("GET","git/blobs/"+entry["sha"])
    assert base64.b64decode(blob["content"]).decode()==link["target"]
print(json.dumps({"verified":True,"commit":commit,
                  "links":[{"path":x["path"],"target":x["target"],"mode":x["mode"]} for x in links]}))
